description.zh: 浏览 VINNER 旗下 MEDIKEEP、CAREKEEP、INDUKEEP 与 OEM/ODM 擦拭产品规格与应用场景。
description.en: Browse specifications and use cases across the MEDIKEEP, CAREKEEP, INDUKEEP, and OEM/ODM wiping lines.

title.zh: 医疗、护理与工业擦拭产品。
title.en: Medical, care, and industrial wiping products.

body.zh: MEDIKEEP 面向医疗感染控制，CAREKEEP 面向个人护理清洁，INDUKEEP 面向工业油污与高强度擦拭，OEM/ODM 面向定制开发与品牌代工。四条产品线共享稳定基材、可靠包装和批次追溯体系。
body.en: MEDIKEEP serves medical infection control, CAREKEEP supports personal care cleansing, INDUKEEP handles industrial oil and high-strength wiping, and OEM/ODM supports custom development and private-label manufacturing. All four lines share stable substrates, reliable packaging, and batch traceability.

hero.alt: VINNER 擦拭产品和使用场景

summary.zh: 面向医院、诊所、实验室和公共卫生场景，围绕表面消毒、皮肤准备和感染控制流程建立产品组合。
summary.en: Built for hospitals, clinics, labs, and public-health settings across surface disinfection, skin preparation, and infection-control workflows.

products.zh: 主要包括酒精消毒湿巾、临床表面消毒湿巾和 CHG 清洁巾。
products.en: Includes alcohol disinfectant wipes, clinical surface disinfectant wipes, and CHG wash cloths.

detail.zh: MEDIKEEP 强调有效成分、材料兼容性、低残留和可追溯批次，帮助医疗和护理团队把高频接触面、设备表面和患者护理流程管理得更稳定。
detail.en: MEDIKEEP focuses on active ingredients, material compatibility, low residue, and batch traceability so care teams can manage high-touch surfaces, equipment, and patient-care workflows with more control.

lines.alt: 医疗感染控制擦拭场景

uses.zh: 医院、诊所和实验室的高频接触面清洁
uses.en: High-touch surface cleaning in hospitals, clinics, and labs

uses.en: Infection control, care preparation, and clinical-area maintenance

uses.zh: 需要 SDS、批次和合规资料支持的客户项目
uses.en: Customer projects requiring SDS, batch, and compliance documentation

skus.title: Alcohol Disinfectant Wipes
skus.alt: Alcohol Disinfectant Wipes 产品场景

body.zh: 适用于高频接触表面、设备外壳和快速挥发清洁需求。
body.en: Built for high-touch surfaces, equipment shells, and fast-evaporation cleaning.

intro.zh: 70% 酒精快速挥发体系，适合医疗空间中高频接触点的日常清洁与消毒前处理。
intro.en: A 70% alcohol fast-dry format for daily cleaning and disinfection preparation on high-touch points in clinical spaces.

医疗空间接触面擦拭场景

highlights.zh: 快速挥发，减少表面残留与等待时间。
highlights.en: Fast evaporation reduces surface residue and waiting time.

highlights.zh: 低掉屑基材，适合设备外壳、推车、床旁高频表面。
highlights.en: Low-lint substrate suits equipment shells, carts, and bedside high-touch surfaces.

highlights.zh: 桶装抽取结构，支持连续作业与现场补给。
highlights.en: Canister dispensing supports continuous work and point-of-use replenishment.

value.zh: 硬质、非多孔高频接触表面
充分润湿表面，并按当地法规与验证要求执行接触时间。
value.en: Fully wet the surface and follow contact time required by local regulation and validation.

usage.zh: 打开桶盖并从中心抽取单片湿巾。
usage.en: Open the canister and pull one wipe from the center feed.

usage.zh: 按一个方向擦拭目标表面，确保表面被均匀润湿。
usage.en: Wipe the target surface in one direction and ensure even wetting.

usage.zh: 使用后及时合盖，避免液体挥发；废弃物按现场规范处理。
usage.en: Close the lid after use to reduce evaporation; dispose of waste according to site procedures.

body.en: Designed for treatment zones, public areas, and non-invasive equipment surfaces with stable disinfecting performance.

intro.zh: 低残留临床消毒擦拭方案，适用于医院、诊所与公共卫生空间的日常表面管理。
intro.en: A low-residue clinical disinfecting wipe for daily surface management in hospitals, clinics, and public health spaces.

highlights.zh: 湿润保持稳定，适合连续擦拭诊疗区域。
highlights.en: Stable wetting supports continuous wiping across treatment zones.

highlights.zh: 翻盖软包便于床旁、护士站和公共区域快速取用。
highlights.en: Flip-top soft pack enables fast access beside beds, nursing stations, and public areas.

highlights.zh: 配方与基材兼顾清洁效率和表面兼容性。
highlights.en: Formula and substrate balance cleaning efficiency with surface compatibility.

value.zh: 诊疗空间、公共区域、非侵入式设备外表面
value.en: Treatment zones, public areas, and non-invasive equipment exteriors

value.zh: 根据目标市场法规、微生物谱和接触时间进行第三方验证。
value.en: Validate against target-market regulation, organism spectrum, and contact time.

usage.zh: 打开翻盖后取出湿巾，避免手部接触未使用湿巾。
usage.en: Open the flip lid and remove one wipe without touching unused wipes.

usage.zh: 由洁净区域向污染区域擦拭，单片湿巾不跨区域复用。
usage.en: Wipe from clean to contaminated areas and do not reuse one wipe across zones.

usage.zh: 使用后压紧翻盖，保持包装密封。
usage.en: Press the flip lid closed after use to preserve pack seal integrity.

value.zh: 按医疗机构流程与当地法规使用，不用于开放性伤口。

usage.zh: 打开单片包装后立即使用，按护理流程擦拭目标区域。

usage.zh: 避免重复污染；使用后按医疗废弃物规范处理。

summary.zh: 面向床旁护理、老年护理、家庭护理和外出清洁，强调温和肤感、免冲洗效率和使用尊严。
summary.en: For bedside care, elderly care, home care, and on-the-go cleansing, with a focus on gentle skin feel, no-rinse efficiency, and dignified use.

products.zh: 主要包括免冲洗沐浴湿巾、沐浴手套、洗发浴帽、乳霜护理湿巾和纯水婴儿湿巾。
products.en: Includes no-rinse bathing wipes, bathing gloves, shampoo caps, cream care wipes, and pure water baby wipes.

detail.zh: CAREKEEP 更关注皮肤接触体验、含液量、布感和包装便利性。它覆盖床旁沐浴、头发清洁、失禁皮肤护理、母婴清洁和家庭温和清洁等场景。
detail.en: CAREKEEP centers on skin contact, liquid loading, cloth feel, and pack convenience across bedside bathing, hair cleansing, incontinence skin care, baby care, and gentle family cleansing.

skus.title: VINNERLOVE Rinse-free Bathing Wipes
skus.alt: VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴湿巾包装正反面

body.zh: 8片式免冲洗全身沐浴湿巾，兼顾清洁、保湿和床旁护理效率。
body.en: An 8-wipe no-rinse full-body bathing system for cleansing, moisturizing, and efficient bedside care.

intro.zh: VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴湿巾将身体清洁与皮肤保湿整合到一包 8 片的床旁沐浴方案，适合卧床、术后、老年护理、长期照护和旅行应急清洁。
intro.en: VINNERLOVE Rinse-free Bathing Wipes combine body cleansing and skin moisturizing in one 8-wipe bedside bathing system for bedridden, post-operative, elderly-care, long-term-care, travel, and emergency cleansing scenarios.

gallery.alt: VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴湿巾包装正反面
VINNERLOVE 免冲洗沐浴湿巾使用场景
温和个人护理和身体清洁场景
家庭护理和床旁清洁用品

highlights.zh: 100gsm 超厚无纺布与 20 x 30 cm 大尺寸设计，覆盖面积更大，适合全身清洁护理。
highlights.en: 100gsm ultra-thick nonwoven and a 20 x 30 cm oversized sheet give broader coverage for full-body care.

highlights.zh: 每包 8 片，对应身体 8 个部位，帮助护理流程更卫生、更规范。
highlights.en: Each 8-wipe pack maps to eight body zones, helping care teams follow a cleaner and more standardized routine.

highlights.zh: 免冲洗护理液可减少用水、脸盆和毛巾依赖，并支持微波加热提升舒适度。
highlights.en: The no-rinse lotion reduces reliance on water, basins, and towels, with microwave warming support for comfort.

usage.zh: 打开包装，每次取出一片湿巾；如需温热体验，可将整包在低于 750W 的微波炉中加热不超过 15 秒，并在使用前测试温度。
usage.en: Open the pack and remove one wipe at a time. For a warm bathing experience, microwave the whole pack below 750W for no more than 15 seconds and test wipe temperature before use.

usage.zh: 建议按 8 片式顺序清洁颈部与躯干、背部、左右手臂与腋下、臀部、腹股沟、左右腿足；每片湿巾用于一个身体部位。
usage.en: Use the 8-wipe sequence across neck and torso, back, left and right arm with axilla, buttocks, groin, and left and right leg with foot; use one wipe per body area.

usage.zh: 使用后无需冲洗；用过的湿巾请丢弃且不要冲入马桶，开封后请重新密封以保持湿润。
usage.en: No rinsing is required. Dispose of used wipes and do not flush; reseal the pack after opening to retain moisture.

value.zh: 可微波加热，低于 750W 且不超过 15 秒
value.en: Microwavable below 750W for no more than 15 seconds

highlights.zh: 手套式结构贴合手部，清洁时更易操控和移动，提高床旁沐浴效率。

usage.en: No rinsing is required. Dispose of used gloves and do not flush; reseal after opening to retain moisture.

highlights.en: 85gsm ultra-thick multilayer nonwoven is soft, comfortable, and durable for hair and scalp cleansing.

highlights.zh: 充分浸润清洁液，帮助湿润头发与头皮，使清洁过程更充分、舒适。

usage.zh: 将浴帽戴在头上，轻轻揉搓头发和头皮，直至清洁完成。
usage.en: Place the cap on the head and gently massage hair and scalp until cleansing is complete.

usage.zh: 无需冲洗；如有需要可用毛巾擦干，使用后请妥善丢弃。
usage.en: No rinsing is required. Towel dry if needed and dispose of the used cap properly.

value.zh: 可微波加热，低于 550W 且不超过 15 秒
value.en: Microwavable below 550W for no more than 15 seconds

value.zh: 免冲洗头发与头皮清洁护理
value.en: No-rinse hair and scalp cleansing care

highlights.zh: 4合1护理逻辑：清洁、保湿、舒缓、屏障防护，减少传统多步骤护理复杂度。
highlights.en: A 4-in-1 care logic combines cleansing, moisturizing, soothing, and barrier protection to simplify multi-step care.

highlights.zh: 金黄洋甘菊提取物、金缕梅提取物与屏障体系，帮助舒缓脆弱及潮湿暴露皮肤。
highlights.en: Chamomile extract, witch hazel extract, and a barrier system help soothe fragile and moisture-exposed skin.

highlights.zh: 含 4% 二甲基硅油和 6% 液体石蜡，在皮肤表面形成透气防护层。
highlights.en: 4% dimethicone and 6% liquid paraffin form a breathable protective barrier on skin.

usage.zh: 打开包装，取出一片湿巾，轻柔清洁受影响或潮湿暴露的皮肤区域。
usage.en: Open the pack and remove one wipe, then gently cleanse affected or moisture-exposed skin.

usage.zh: 必要时让皮肤自然干燥，无需冲洗；每个身体部位建议使用新的湿巾。
usage.en: Allow skin to air dry if needed. No rinsing is required; use a fresh wipe for each body area.

usage.zh: 开封后请重新密封包装，使用后丢弃且不要冲入马桶；若皮肤问题持续或加重，请寻求专业医护评估。
usage.en: Reseal after opening. Dispose after use and do not flush; seek professional care if skin issues persist or worsen.

value.zh: 含乳霜配方的 4合1 皮肤护理湿巾
